span.p:
ToT
多候选 -> 评估 -> 剪枝
成本随宽度深度增加

div.style: color: rgb(74, 40, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
GoT
推理节点可合并复用
收益依任务、评估器与预算

div.style: color: rgb(74, 40, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Generator / Maker
生成计划、代码或答案

div.style: color: rgb(74, 40, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Critic / Evaluator
事实、逻辑、完整性、测试
PASS 或具体反馈

div.style: color: rgb(74, 40, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Bounded Repair
依据失败证据修复
最大轮次后升级

div.style: color: rgb(74, 40, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Objective Gate
测试 / Schema / 业务真值
通过才算完成

div.style: color: rgb(21, 56, 56) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
记忆模块设计
感知 / 短期 / 长期 / 实体
读 -> 用 -> 写

div.style: color: rgb(21, 56, 56) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
长短期存储
messages / 向量库 / 元数据
粒度与新鲜度

div.style: color: rgb(21, 56, 56) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
记忆压缩
滑动窗口 / 摘要
重要性 / 结构化抽取

div.style: color: rgb(21, 56, 56) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Perceptual Memory
当前原始输入
单次调用

div.style: color: rgb(21, 56, 56) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Short-term Memory
messages / 工作状态
当前任务可见

div.style: color: rgb(21, 56, 56) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Long-term Memory
跨任务持久化
语义 / 情节 / 程序

div.style: color: rgb(21, 56, 56) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Entity Memory
用户、项目、预算、偏好
结构化事实

div.style: color: rgb(21, 56, 56) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Hybrid Memory Store
向量语义检索 + SQL/KV 精确查询
metadata / tenant / timestamp

div.style: color: rgb(21, 56, 56) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Memory Lifecycle
任务前召回 -> 执行中使用
结束后抽取、去重、冲突消解

div.style: color: rgb(21, 56, 56) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Sliding Window
简单便宜
可能丢失早期关键决策

div.style: color: rgb(21, 56, 56) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Summary Compression
保留语义主线
可能损失精确细节

div.style: color: rgb(21, 56, 56) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Importance Filtering
按价值而非时间筛选
规则或模型打分

div.style: color: rgb(21, 56, 56) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Structured Extraction
事实、状态、决策、SOP
高信息密度

div.style: color: rgb(21, 56, 56) !important; display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Prompt Caching
计算层优化
不等于信息压缩

div.style: color: rgb(21, 56, 56) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Memory Governance
来源、作用域、TTL、删除
过期和冲突不能静默覆盖

div.style: color: rgb(74, 30, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Multi-Agent 基础
专业分工 / 隔离 / 并行
Pipeline / Fan-out / Debate

div.style: color: rgb(74, 30, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Single vs Multi
Context / 专业分工 / 并行
渐进式演进

div.style: color: rgb(74, 30, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
协作与动态切换
消息 / 共享状态
Static / Dynamic / Handoff

div.style: color: rgb(74, 30, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Single-Agent
一个循环、链路短、易调试
适合流程清晰中等任务

div.style: color: rgb(74, 30, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Orchestrator
拆解 / 路由 / 收集 / 合成
中心化责任边界

div.style: color: rgb(74, 30, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Worker Agents
专业上下文与工具池
局部任务、独立验收

div.style: color: rgb(74, 30, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Sequential Pipeline
A -> B -> C
依赖清晰

div.style: color: rgb(74, 30, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Fan-out / Fan-in
独立任务并行
结果聚合

div.style: color: rgb(74, 30, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Debate / Review
多个候选与 Critic
多方一致不等于事实正确

div.style: color: rgb(74, 30, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Message Passing
队列 / 事件 / 解耦
异步、可重放

div.style: color: rgb(74, 30, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Shared State
全局状态 + 局部状态
增量更新、避免覆盖

div.style: color: rgb(74, 30, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Static Router
规则、allowlist、fallback
稳定可预测

div.style: color: rgb(74, 30, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Dynamic Router
LLM 选择下一 Agent
灵活但有成本和误路由

div.style: color: rgb(74, 30, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Handoff
当前 Agent 交接下一 Agent
必须防循环与越权

div.style: color: rgb(74, 30, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Collaboration Control
任务 ID / depth / budget
timeout / cancellation / audit

div.style: color: rgb(23, 60, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
手写 vs 框架
核心透明度 / 调试 / 版本
核心手写、周边借用

div.style: color: rgb(23, 60, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Handwritten Core
messages / loop / tool dispatch
控制规则显式，模型与外部结果仍需验证

div.style: color: rgb(23, 60, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Framework Layer
LangChain / LangGraph 等
快速 POC、生态丰富

div.style: color: rgb(23, 60, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Pragmatic Hybrid
核心控制面手写
解析、Tracing、向量客户端复用

div.style: color: rgb(23, 60, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Observability
trace / token / latency
tool call / state diff

div.style: color: rgb(23, 60, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Dependency Governance
版本锁定 / 兼容测试
升级与回滚策略

div.style: color: rgb(37, 37, 37) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Durable State
目标 / 计划 / 当前步骤
checkpoint / resume

div.style: color: rgb(37, 37, 37) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Budget & Stop
轮次 / Token / Cost / Timeout
重复动作 / 无进展

div.style: color: rgb(37, 37, 37) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Security Boundary
allowlist / approval / sandbox
Prompt Injection / secrets

div.style: color: rgb(37, 37, 37) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Evaluation
任务成功 / 工具正确 / 证据质量
延迟、成本、人工接受率

div.style: color: rgb(37, 37, 37) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Human Review
高风险审批、领域真值
最终接受与升级
